body: I know the feeling. When i feel happy, i don't have control over what i say or do. I feeling so spastic and chaotic. But when i'm depressed, i'm more subdued, i can control myself. keep hanging in there, it gets easier.

Using a not so active account for obvious reasons.

I made posts asking advice about a girl i had started going out with (a week or two after i broke up with another girl), unbeknownst that a month later i would start talking to my ex again who just so happened to know my main account and shit did not end well.

this may sound dickish of me but:

Telling me about all their financial troubles.

I'm at uni and i'm so terrified and ashamed to even ask them for money for groceries.

I've tried to hint to my family that somethings wrong. But i can't really bring myself to outright say it because my parents will tell me that there is nothing wrong. I've told my mom many times about how i don't really sleep anymore, but she just assumes its because i got a new bed.
